spec.scene: A small circular patch of warm wooden floorboards sits in soft darkness. In the center stands a comfortable olive-green armchair draped with a cream knitted throw. Beside it on the right, a round wooden table holds a steaming ceramic mug and a glowing amber lamp that washes everything in soft light. A leafy potted fern rests on the left edge, and a pair of gray slip-on shoes sits untied by the front edge.
spec.title: Just Fine
spec.caption: Nothing really happened, and that was just fine.
